description: Tables of Drinking Water Threats is a dataset listed in Ontario open data catalogue, an open data portal, published or maintained by Environment, Conservation and Parks. We've made tables that include the 21 drinking water quality threat activities, set out in O. Reg. 287/07, which may pose a risk to a municipal drinking water supply. The tables also provide all the circumstances associated with each threat. The tables separate drinking water quality threats into two sections: chemical and pathogen. Coverage: Ontario. The portal files it under the publisher Environment, Conservation and Parks. Its tags are Environment and Natural Resources, Environnement et richesses naturelles, Health and wellness, Santé et bien-être. It offers 4 resource(s) in PDF, XLSX. The portal shows 2024-05-09 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Government Licence – Ontario. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-ontario-portal.
